equation_summary: RelPositionMultiHeadedAttention (Transformer-XL style): scores = [(q + u)·kᵀ + rel_shift((q + v)·pᵀ)] / sqrt(d_k) where u,v are per-head learned bias vectors and p = linear_pos(pos_enc) over 2T−1 relative positions; noncausal softmax with source mask (and optional chunk mask) applied by -inf fill with all-masked rows zeroed post-softmax; output = softmax(scores)·v then linear_out. The Conformer block wraps this with external macaron FFN (×0.5), a depthwise convolution module, second FFN, LayerNorms and residuals. A simplified_attention_score variant replaces (q+v)·p with linear_pos(pos_enc) directly (per-head scalar position term).
state_shape: none (encoder; streaming chunk_forward keeps external attention left-context cache [1,left_ctx,D] and conv cache)
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM `E[QKV/relative-position frontend] ; U1.S(noncausal,exact bias) ; E[convolution/FFN/norm/residual]`: the mixer is exactly softmax attention with an additive bias term (matrix_bd, the rel-shifted position score) — bias construction (linear_pos, pos_bias_u/v, rel_shift) and the conv/FFN/macaron/norm stack are all external E stages (attention.py:116-147, 185-222; conformer.py:101-136).

CONFIRM 'Relative-position variant and full encoder; no attention-only Conformer claim': two score variants exist (full u/v-bias rel-shift vs simplified_attention_score, attention.py:43-55, 83-114) and the block is noncausal full-context by default with a separate streaming chunk_forward (conformer.py:138-197) using left_context caches — the complete encoder claim needs the variant + both modes, matching the blocker.

NOTE: the bias is added pre-softmax at 1/sqrt(d_k) scale (attention.py:147) — it fits U1.S's bias field exactly (bias_ij = rel_shift((q+v)·pᵀ)/√d), so no new core semantics are needed; rel_shift is a strided-view reindex (attention.py:60-81), an external ordinary op.
NOTE: streaming mode uses separate att_cache/conv_cache and chunk masks (conformer.py:57-79, 167-195); cache policy is external per the ownership rule.
direction_justification: The mixer is exactly U1.S with an additive relative-position bias and noncausal mask; the bias construction, convolution, macaron FFNs and norms are all external ordinary operators — zero new core semantics, only an external module + recipe.
